retention.backupReplay: all retained checkpoints; admission blocked until reconciliation complete

journal.storage: kernel fsync append-only journal on separate volume excluded from Kernel DB destruction/restore
journal.lossBoundary: Kernel DB loss only; shared host/volume loss unsupported and fail closed
journal.admission: fsync intent before DB transaction; fsync committed marker after DB commit and before durable acknowledgement or external dispatch
journal.fence: stop admission and dispatch before highWatermark; verify epoch and contiguous chain through highWatermark
journal.authorization: current trusted tenant/store recovery service scope; audit reads and resolutions; no business/AI access
journal.auditRecovery: append RecoveryObserved with original IDs/digests, journal evidence and restore checkpoint; never invent original audit commit
journal.recoveryRange: entire journal epoch union restored DB unresolved operations; checkpoint after admission fence, DB transaction drain and committed-marker fsync; afterSequence optimization only with proven complete union

scenarios.inject: retry at 30 days minus/at/plus one second and years later
scenarios.expect: same key/digest same action, no additional effect; no TTL at audit boundary

scenarios.inject: same retained key different canonical input
ledger/inbox/key absent or hypothetical expiry outside confirmed complete history
scenarios.expect: INCONSISTENT_STATE or unknown; no automatic new execution

scenarios.inject: retention/cleanup during unknown or pending compensation
scenarios.expect: all dedup and journal records retained; unresolved not deleted

scenarios.inject: checkpoint -> local commit -> ERP applied -> ack lost -> destroy only Kernel DB -> restore checkpoint; no controller ID input
scenarios.expect: enumerate surviving journal finds original key/digest/actor/action/operation; reconcile applied; no resend; reconstructed recovery audit; duplicate effect zero; missing local commits reported

scenarios.inject: crash before DB commit or between DB commit and journal committed marker
scenarios.expect: intent discovered; no inferred commit or blind replay; classify manual if commit cannot be proved

scenarios.inject: missing/truncated record, wrong epoch, hash mismatch or unavailable journal
scenarios.expect: INCONSISTENT_STATE/UNAVAILABLE; admission and dispatch remain fenced; no false completeness

scenarios.inject: cross-tenant enumeration or revoked recovery service scope
scenarios.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED; no keys/input leaked; no mutation
